end.summary:
Reyansh practised identifying top, front and side views of solids.
They correctly described views of balls, cones, cylinders, cubes, grounds and birthday caps.
They matched views to objects accurately across the activities.
They first thought another person would see the same view, then corrected this using the cup and handle example.
Homework was discussed: describing a fridge from the top and side.
end.parentNote: Reyansh practised describing how solids look from the top, front and side, and matching views to objects. They used features such as round tops, square faces and rectangular side views to explain their choices. There was one mix-up about another person seeing the same view; it was corrected later by considering the cup handle from the other side. At home, ask Reyansh to describe three household objects from two different viewing positions.
